_comment: Enemy/ally behavior trees (docs/design/enemy-ai.md). A unit picks a profile with the 'ai' key in units.json; no key = ai.default, which plays any loadout from its skill roles. Scores are expected HP swing. All numbers are provisional and retuned here, never in code.

fragments._comment: Take the best firing position (close in, keep range, avoid spikes), then use whichever skill is worth the most AP: attack, heal, buff or debuff compete on one scale.
Nothing to attack: walk toward a wounded ally and heal it.
Phase change: below half health the unit uses a buff skill on itself, once per battle. Does nothing for a unit that has no buff skill.

Boss phase rule: once the action phase reaches 2 (the core is exposed), the boss closes in and commits to its area skill. The condition is false for a unit without FBossGoals, so the single-phase fallback guardian is unchanged.
Cinder Warden phase rule: once the action phase reaches 2 (Wildfire) it closes in and drops its burning field every turn.
Cinder Warden cycle: on its 3rd, 6th, 9th... turn it drops its burning field even in phase 1 (TurnIs every 3 offset 2 is true on the unit's 3rd turn).
Chain Warden phase rule: once the action phase reaches 2 (Unchained) it commits to charging through the line.
Ash Hierophant phase rule: once the action phase reaches 2 (the chanters are dead) it commits to raining fire over an area (imp_firebomb: magical, follows its magic attack).

profiles._comment: Boss: the default behavior plus phase rules. Skills added to a boss are picked up by role; a phase rule needs only a skill of the right role in its loadout. intent_mode overrides the hybrid intent rule (hybrid = the default rule; tile/unit force it for debugging).

Boss part (the guardian's hearts): a stationary turret. It never repositions (no Engage), it fires the best skill from where it stands, else it waits. Authored with move_ap 0, so the fix is the profile, not the AP value.
Cinder Warden: burning field every third turn, every turn in phase 2, else the default fight.
Chain Warden: the default fight (hook and shackle score by value) plus a phase-2 charge.
Ash Hierophant: the default fight while its chanters live, a phase-2 fire rain after.
Powder Imp: it only closes in. It has no UseSkill node, so its blast can only come from the tile intent it commits at round start — always telegraphed.
